summary: Document independent RPC and ingress modes, HTTPS setup and public-origin diagnostics
details: Explain local-node/external RPC separately from bundled/external ingress, and distinguish the advertised frontend and wallet origin from host listener ports. Document that configure --explorer-url selects bundled ingress and that the current CLI has no certificate or HTTPS-port options.

Provide source-configuration examples for bundled HTTPS and existing host Nginx, including certificate renewal, port forwarding and the required prepare lifecycle. Correct the external-ingress reference to state that loopback bindings are required even for public exposure.

Separate successful local and external browser checks from failures when the server revisits its public origin. Describe connection timing, intermittent NAT/firewall paths, split-DNS port constraints and the v0.2.4 limitation; keep check --url explicitly scoped to its override and never repair local reachability by replacing the visitor origin with loopback.
